shared_elements: human figures shown in profile-like frontal-schematic form
repeated small marks or signs arranged in rows
justification: Both surfaces are incised linear compositions containing small human figures with raised arms and rows of repeated small signs, but that is about as generic as figural rock/stone engraving gets. A is dominated by a huge multi-crewed boat with vertical stroke-figures along its hull, while B shows a compact panel of robed figures adoring a larger central figure beneath rectangular sign-groups; neither the subjects nor their relationships correspond.
